descripcion: A vulnerability was determined in MaysWind AriaNg-Native up to 1.3.14. Affected by this issue is the function shell.openPath of the file main/ipc/main-process.js of the component IPC Handler. This manipulation of the argument dir causes improper input validation. The attack can be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.3.15 can resolve this issue. Patch name: ac5a4bcf102f605b160f19fcc9fbaec67f9596d7. The SiteOrigin CSS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'class' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires a Contributor-level or higher attacker to store a crafted class attribute value in a post, which then fires when a user with the edit_theme_options capability opens the Visual Inspector on the affected post and clicks anywhere in the preview iframe. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that a third-party plugin providing wp_kses_post()-filtered unauthenticated front-end submission is installed and configured, and a moderator approves the submission. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with contributor-level access and above. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The CodePeople Post Map for Google Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'cpm_map[api_key]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The settings form nonce is itself rendered on the Subscriber-accessible page (reachable via a trailing-slash bypass of the slug guard), making nonce verification no real barrier to the unauthorized save. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

The SchemaEngine AI – AI Schema Markup, Reviews & Rich Snippets for SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via WebPage JSON-LD Description in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the target page renders a core/latest-comments block with the displayExcerpt option enabled, causing comment content to be incorporated into the WebPage JSON-LD description output in wp_head. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The Photo Gallery, Sliders, Proofing and Themes – NextGEN Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the site administrator to have configured the Thickbox lightbox effect with the "Try to apply to all images" context (thumbEffectContext=all_images), and exploitation additionally depends on an administrator approving the attacker's initial comment so that subsequent comments from that author are auto-approved. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The Product Import Export for WooCommerce – CSV Product Importer & Exporter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author (initial store via wp-comments-post.php) / CSV cell on import' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.6.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit requires an administrator to approve the attacker's review, then export and re-import it using the plugin's default column mapping, with the import taking the INSERT branch — which occurs automatically on any site whose database table prefix is not the literal 'wp_', when the CSV has no comment_ID mapping, or when the original review has been trashed. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 4.70 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

The Contact Form to Any API plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'your-message (any CF7 form field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The malicious payload is stored via a single unauthenticated POST to Contact Form 7's public REST feedback endpoint, which uses permission_callback __return_true and requires no authentication or prior interaction to submit. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The WPBot – AI ChatBot for WordPress & Growth Suite: SEO, AI Writer, Email Marketing, Social Media plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'text' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is triggered when an administrator opens the Chat Sessions screen, at which point the plugin's bundled Bootstrap 3.3.7 affix data-API passes the attacker-controlled data-target attribute value to jQuery as HTML, executing the injected script in the administrator's session. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The BlockStrap Page Builder – Bootstrap Blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.1.65 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that the attacker has previously had at least one comment approved for a given name and email address, allowing subsequent comments from that author to bypass moderation under WordPress's default policy; exploitation is also limited to sites using a block theme, which is the WordPress default. 21/11/2026 21/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH
